parameters.description: Filter invoices up to this date

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search invoice number or vendor name

200.description: Paginated list of invoices with aging info

post.description: Creates a new invoice in PENDING status. Can be linked to a PO (poId) or standalone (provide projectId + vendorId). When linked to a PO: due date auto-calculated from payment terms, retainage inherited from PO. Document upload is optional.

with-line-items.summary: Invoice with line items (linked to PO)

final-with-retainage.summary: Final invoice with retainage and tax

201.description: Invoice created. May include overageWarning and/or finalInvoiceWarning.

overageWarning.description: Set when invoice exceeds PO balance

finalInvoiceWarning.description: Set when PO has remaining balance after final invoice

400.description: Validation error, duplicate invoice number, or PO not in ISSUED/PARTIALLY_PAID status

404.description: PO or invoice document not found

get.summary: List pending invoices across all projects
get.description: Returns all PENDING invoices sorted by due date (soonest first). Useful for approvers to see what needs action.

200.description: Paginated list of pending invoices with aging

get.summary: Get invoice detail with PO balance context

put.description: Partial update. Only PENDING, unpaid invoices can be updated. Retainage auto-recalculated when totalAmount or retainagePercent changes.

400.description: Only PENDING invoices can be updated
Only PENDING invoices can be deleted

post.description: Transitions invoice from PENDING to APPROVED. Creator cannot approve their own invoice (segregation of duties).

400.description: Only PENDING invoices can be approved, or creator cannot approve own invoice

post.description: Transitions invoice from PENDING to REJECTED. Requires a reason (minimum 20 characters).

value.reason: Invoice amount does not match agreed PO line item pricing. Please resubmit.

400.description: Only PENDING invoices can be rejected

post.summary: Mark an approved invoice as paid
post.description: Records payment on an APPROVED invoice. Disputed invoices must be resolved before payment.

200.description: Invoice marked as paid with PO impact details

400.description: Only APPROVED invoices can be paid, or invoice is disputed

post.description: Marks an unpaid invoice as disputed. Disputed invoices cannot be paid until the dispute is resolved.

value.disputeReason: Quantities delivered do not match invoice quantities

400.description: Cannot dispute a paid invoice or already disputed

value.resolution: Vendor agreed to credit $500 on next invoice for quantity discrepancy

post.summary: Add a line item to an invoice
post.description: Adds a line item to a PENDING invoice. Amount auto-computed as qty x unitPrice. Returns amountMismatch warning if line items total differs from invoice total.

with-po-link.summary: Line item linked to PO line item

201.description: Line item added. May include amountMismatch warning.

400.description: Only PENDING invoices can have line items added

404.description: Invoice, cost code, or PO line item not found

put.description: Partial update of a line item on a PENDING invoice. Amount auto-recalculated.

200.description: Line item updated. May include amountMismatch warning.

400.description: Only PENDING invoices can have line items updated

404.description: Invoice or line item not found

delete.summary: Remove a line item from an invoice

400.description: Only PENDING invoices can have line items removed

404.description: Invoice or line item not found

get.summary: Get invoice aging report for a project
get.description: Returns unpaid invoices grouped by aging buckets (current, 30-60, 60-90, 90+ days). Sorted by most overdue first.

parameters.name: asOfDate
parameters.description: Calculate aging as of this date (defaults to today)

200.description: Aging report with buckets and invoice details

get.summary: Get invoice summary KPIs for a project
get.description: Returns invoice counts and totals by status and type, disputed/overdue counts, and average days to approval/payment.

get.summary: List invoices for a purchase order
get.description: Returns all invoices linked to a PO with payment progress summary (invoiced %, paid %, remaining balance).
Returns paginated invoices for a vendor with vendor-level summary (total invoiced, paid, outstanding, avg days to pay).

InvoiceCreateRequest.description: Provide either poId (PO-linked) or both projectId + vendorId (standalone). Document upload is optional.

poId.description: Purchase Order ID (optional — if omitted, provide projectId + vendorId)

dueDate.description: Auto-calculated from PO payment terms if not provided (defaults to 30 days)

invoiceDocumentId.description: File ID of the uploaded invoice document (optional)

retainagePercent.description: Auto-inherited from PO if not provided

InvoiceUpdateRequest.description: All fields optional (partial update). At least one field required.

poLineItemId.description: Link to a PO line item

InvoiceLineItemUpdateRequest.description: All fields optional. At least one required.
